name: Princess Milk ~Junyuu Ero Icha Seikatsu♪ Ohime-sama no Bonyuu Igai Nomenai Karada ni!?~
original_name: プリンセスミルク ～授乳エロイチャ生活♪お姫様の母乳以外飲めない身体に!?～
source:
Masaki Katakura is an ordinary student with nothing special about him.
One day, he’s summoned to a royal palace in another world, where Princess Monica asks him to save her kingdom by… having a child with her.
Monica explains that by bearing the next generation, she’ll gain immense magical power—enough to bring peace to the land.
To make things more complicated, the food in this world doesn’t agree with Masaki’s body. The only thing that can sustain him is Monica’s breast milk, which carries the royal family’s special qualities!
And so begins Masaki’s sweet new life—unlimited access to the gentle, pure Princess Monica’s milk, and a whole lot of baby-making.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ055616.html/]dlsite[/url]]
translation:
片仓正树是一个普通的学生，没有什么特别之处。
有一天，他被召唤到另一个世界的一座皇宫，莫妮卡公主要求他通过……与她生一个孩子来拯救她的王国。
莫妮卡解释说，通过生育下一代，她将获得巨大的魔法力量——足以给这片土地带来和平。
更复杂的是，这个世界的食物并不适合正树的身体。唯一能支撑他的就是莫妮卡的母乳，这母乳承载着王室的特殊品质！
正树甜蜜的新生活就这样开始了——无限量地享用温柔、纯净的莫妮卡公主的牛奶，并参与大量的婴儿制作工作。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ055616.html/]dlsite[/url]]
